at_a_glance.label: Question
at_a_glance.text: How much of a race result comes from the driver, and how much from the car?

at_a_glance.label: Model
at_a_glance.text: Connect a tractable race-time model to observable finishing ranks, then use separate datasets to benchmark constructor effects and compare drivers with their cars.

at_a_glance.label: Finding
at_a_glance.text: Constructor quality is the dominant source of variation; the driver comparison then identifies expected performances that beat the benchmark implied by the car.

title: Sparse optimisation with FC-GCG
summary: A visual pedagogical implementation showing how fully-corrective conditional gradients build sparse solutions one atom at a time.

article.title: Sparsity by design: building solutions one atom at a time
article.lead: A plain-language tour of our Mathematical Programming paper on fully-corrective generalized conditional gradient methods — with the whole idea worked out on the lasso, where you can see every moving part.
article.author: Silvio Fanzon

at_a_glance.label: Problem
at_a_glance.text: Can an optimisation method preserve sparsity throughout the computation and stop with an exact certificate?

at_a_glance.label: Algorithm
at_a_glance.text: FC-GCG alternates atom insertion with full correction over the active set, keeping every iterate sparse by construction.

at_a_glance.label: Behaviour
at_a_glance.text: In the pedagogical lasso experiment it inserts 11 atoms, stops at iteration 12 with an optimality certificate, and never exceeds the solution sparsity.

title: Dynamic inverse problems with optimal transport
summary: Algorithms that reconstruct moving sources from incomplete and noisy measurements, supported by theory and numerical experiments.

at_a_glance.label: Problem
at_a_glance.text: Recover time-dependent structure when every observation is indirect and severely undersampled.

at_a_glance.label: Approach
at_a_glance.text: Convex optimisation, optimal transport, sparse representations and numerical experiments.

at_a_glance.label: Beyond maths
at_a_glance.text: Research software, validation, international collaboration and long-term project ownership.
